author: Rayzurbock
betaReleaseNotes: Beta 3.0.1.1 (2026-11-09) — update-check rework: the button reads 'Check For Update', the version info refreshes when you check, rechecks are 1 minute (button) / 30 minutes (page load); the version-info link and release notes now render as HTML. Next stable release will be 3.0.2.
releaseNotes: 3.0.1: Text Only announcements — send any announcement as text to notification devices (Hubitat mobile app, Telegram, Pushover) instead of, or alongside, speech. Set at the app, group, or per-device-type level. Simpler install (speech-device-type page removed; setup goes straight to Configure Defaults). Event groups can be removed again — the Remove button is back on the group page. Help headings no longer show stray double lines; tagline and About now mention text announcements; Cash.me is now Cash App in Donations.
